{{Quote|I'd like you to meet Commander Colt of the Rancor Battalion.|[[Bric/Legends|Bric]]|<ref name="Clone Cadets" />}}
'''Rancor Battalion''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|military]] [[Battalion/Legends|unit]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], led by the [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Colt/Legends|Colt]]. The unit also included [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|Advanced Recon Force troopers]]. Prior to the [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|battle of Kamino]], the unit's ARCs were tasked with overseeing the training of [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadets]] in [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]]. During the battle, the Rancor Battalion engaged attacking [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] forces. Under Rancor Battalion ARC trooper [[Havoc (ARC trooper)/Legends|Havoc]], members of the battalion defended a hangar bay when it was breached by a [[Trident (starship)/Legends|Separatist trident]] and [[Aqua droid/Legends|Aqua droid]] units. At the same time, three Advanced Recon Force troopers, led by Rancor Battalion ARC trooper [[Blitz/Legends|Blitz]], were sent to destroy a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] trident with a rocket launcher, succeeding. Commander Colt and ARC trooper Havoc were killed, with Blitz and [[Unidentified Advanced Recon Commando|one other commando]] being the only surviving ARCs.
